headlines.title_en: A-Shares Close: STAR 50 Opens High, Falls Over 1% on Low; Over 4,300 Stocks Decline Market-Wide
headlines.summary_en: 1. The market opened higher but closed lower across the day, with the three major indices turning red in late trading. Pharmaceutical and medical stocks extended gains, with multiple stocks including Boji Pharmaceutical, Wanbang Pharmaceutical, and Longshengongfa hitting the daily limit. The supernode concept strengthened, with stocks like Gongjin Electronics and Xingwang Ruijie hitting limit-up. Computing power leasing concepts rallied intraday, with Chengdi Xiangjiang hitting three consecutive limit-ups, and Lianon Technology and Qunxing Toys among those hitting limit-up. On the downside, the precious metals sector fell, with Zhaojin Gold and Hunan Silver down over 7%. Decliners outnumbered advancers, with about 4,300 stocks in Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Beijing turning green, and turnover reaching 2.57 trillion yuan today. At close, the Shanghai Composite fell 0.5%, the Shenzhen Component fell 0.87%, and the ChiNext fell 0.45%. 2. In terms of sectors and concepts, pharmaceuticals, medical, supernode, dairy, and baijiu led gains, while precious metals, education, photovoltaic equipment, and real estate led losses. 3. Across the two markets, 1,085 stocks rose, 62 hit limit-up, and 4,041 stocks fell.

headlines.title_en: China Southern Airlines: A-Share Private Placement Application Approved by Shanghai Stock Exchange
headlines.summary_en: China Southern Airlines announced that it recently received the Exchange Review Opinion from the Shanghai Stock Exchange regarding the company's private placement of shares. The application for issuing shares to specific targets by China Southern Airlines Co., Ltd. meets the issuance conditions, listing conditions, and information disclosure requirements. The SSE will submit the application to the CSRC for registration after receiving the company's application documents. The company's issuance of A-shares to specific targets is still subject to approval by the CSRC, and whether and when such approval will be granted remains uncertain.

headlines.title_en: Vice Finance Minister Liao Min attends first BRICS Finance Ministers and Central Bank Governors Meeting of 2026
headlines.summary_en: 【Vice Finance Minister Liao Min Attends First BRICS Finance Ministers and Central Bank Governors Meeting of 2026】From August 12-13, the first BRICS Finance Ministers and Central Bank Governors Meeting of 2026 was held in Jaipur, India. The meeting discussed topics including global economic growth and development, improving the international monetary and financial system, infrastructure investment, customs and taxation, the New Development Bank, and the BRICS Finance Think Tank Network. Vice Finance Minister Liao Min led a delegation to attend the meeting and delivered remarks.

headlines.title: 印度继续对原产于或进口自中国和韩国的邻苯二甲酸酐征收反倾销税
headlines.summary: 印度财政部税收局发布第20/2026-Customs(ADD)号通报称，接受印度商工部于2026年5月7日对原产于或进口自中国和韩国的邻苯二甲酸酐作出的第一次反倾销日落复审肯定性终裁建议，决定继续征收为期5年的反倾销税，分别为中国40.08美元/吨、韩国140.17美元/吨。涉案产品的印度海关编码为29173500。措施自本通报发布于官方公报之日起生效。

headlines.title_en: India Continues Anti-Dumping Duties on Phthalic Anhydride Originating from or Imported from China and South Korea
headlines.summary_en: India's Ministry of Finance, Department of Revenue, issued Notification No. 20/2026-Customs (ADD), stating it accepted the affirmative final findings of the first anti-dumping sunset review on phthalic anhydride originating in or imported from China and South Korea, recommended by the Ministry of Commerce and Industry on May 7, 2026, and decided to continue levying anti-dumping duties for five years, at USD 40.08 per ton for China and USD 140.17 per ton for South Korea. The Indian customs code for the subject goods is 29173500. The measures take effect from the date of publication of this notification in the Official Gazette.

headlines.title: 中国移动：上半年算力服务收入达到人民币529亿元，同比增长14.0%，数据中心收入同比增长13.2%
headlines.summary: 中国移动：上半年算力服务收入达到人民币529亿元，同比增长14.0%。移动云影响力进一步提升，公有云收入规模首次进入国内业界前三。数据中心收入人民币190亿元，同比增长13.2%，其中AIDC收入同比增长486.1%，敏捷交付、算电协同、高阶运维等核心服务能力显著增强。智算服务收入人民币53亿元、增速达130.1%，贡献算力服务收入增量的46.1%。云算应用收入同比增长5.9%，其中移动云盘收入同比增长14.1%。

headlines.title_en: China Mobile: H1 Computing Power Service Revenue Reaches 52.9 Billion Yuan, Up 14.0% YoY; Data Center Revenue Up 13.2% YoY
headlines.summary_en: China Mobile: H1 computing power service revenue reached RMB 52.9 billion, up 14.0% year-on-year. Mobile Cloud's influence further improved, with public cloud revenue scale entering the domestic top three for the first time. Data center revenue reached RMB 19 billion, up 13.2% year-on-year, of which AIDC revenue surged 486.1% year-on-year, with core service capabilities such as agile delivery, computing-power coordination, and high-level operations significantly enhanced. Intelligent computing service revenue reached RMB 5.3 billion, growing 130.1%, contributing 46.1% of the increase in computing power service revenue. Cloud and computing application revenue rose 5.9% year-on-year, with Mobile Cloud Drive revenue up 14.1%.

headlines.title: 天数智芯：预计上半年净利润约6000万元至1.4亿元，同比扭亏为盈
headlines.summary: 天数智芯(09903.HK)公告，预期本集团于2026年6月30日止六个月内将录得净利润约人民币6000万元至人民币1.4亿元，而截至2025年6月30日止六个月则录得净亏损约人民币6.093亿元。董事会认为，本集团于报告期间之业绩扭亏为盈，主要归因于报告期间内按公允价值计入损益的金融资产的公允价值收益介乎约人民币7.3亿元至人民币7.9亿元，其主要由于本集团于一间上海证券交易所上市公司之股份投资产生之未变现净收益大幅增加。

headlines.title_en: Tianshu Zhixin: Expected H1 net profit of about 60 million to 140 million yuan, turning from loss to profit year-on-year
headlines.summary_en: Tianshu Zhixin (09903.HK) announced that it expects to record a net profit of approximately RMB 60 million to RMB 140 million for the six months ended June 30, 2026, compared with a net loss of approximately RMB 609.3 million for the six months ended June 30, 2025. The board believes the turnaround to profitability in the reporting period is mainly due to fair value gains on financial assets measured at fair value through profit or loss, ranging from approximately RMB 730 million to RMB 790 million, primarily driven by a significant increase in unrealized net gains from the group's equity investment in a Shanghai Stock Exchange-listed company.

headlines.title_en: Ministry of Commerce: Continues Anti-Dumping Duties on Single-Mode Optical Fiber Imports from India for 5 Years
headlines.summary_en: The Ministry of Commerce announced that starting August 14, 2026, anti-dumping duties on imported single-mode optical fiber originating in India will continue to be levied for five years. This action is based on the results of an investigation into the likelihood of dumping of single-mode optical fiber originating in India and the likelihood of injury to China's domestic industry.

headlines.title: 中老铁路前7个月进出口货值超200亿元
headlines.summary: 从昆明海关获悉，今年前7个月，经中老铁路进出口货值201.1亿元、同比增长29.9%。据昆明海关统计，今年前7个月，经中老铁路进口东盟热带水果49.2亿元、同比增长14.9%，出口新能源汽车、光伏产品等“新三样”23.1亿元、同比增长306.2%，跨境电商B2B出口货值同比增长1.5倍。其中，进口榴莲15.8万吨，同比增长25.6%。依托中老铁路这条“黄金大通道”，“中国智造南下，东南亚特产北上”双向贸易格局加速形成。（新华社）

headlines.title_en: China-Laos Railway's import-export cargo value exceeds 20 billion yuan in first 7 months
headlines.summary_en: According to Kunming Customs, in the first seven months of this year, the import and export value via the China-Laos Railway reached RMB 20.11 billion, up 29.9% year-on-year. Kunming Customs statistics show that in the first seven months, imports of ASEAN tropical fruits via the China-Laos Railway reached RMB 4.92 billion, up 14.9% year-on-year, while exports of 'new three' items such as new energy vehicles and photovoltaic products reached RMB 2.31 billion, up 306.2% year-on-year, and cross-border e-commerce B2B export value rose 1.5 times year-on-year. Among these, durian imports reached 158,000 tons, up 25.6% year-on-year. Relying on this 'golden corridor' of the China-Laos Railway, a two-way trade pattern of 'Chinese smart manufacturing heading south and Southeast Asian specialties heading north' is accelerating. (Xinhua)

headlines.title: 中国移动：2026年上半年公司营运收入达到人民币5,380亿元，同比下降1.1%
headlines.summary: 中国移动：2026年上半年，公司营运收入达到人民币5,380亿元，同比下降1.1%，同口径实现正增长。其中，主营业务收入达到人民币4,527亿元，同比下降3.1%；其他业务收入为人民币854亿元，同比增长11.2%。算力服务、智能服务收入占主营业务收入比达到22.6%，同比提升2.2个百分点。 股东应占利润为人民币789亿元，同比下降6.3%，同口径实现正增长，每股盈利为人民币3.64元；EBITDA为人民币1,736亿元，同比下降6.6%，EBITDA占主营业务收入比为38.4%；盈利能力保持全球一流运营商领先水平。经营现金净流入为人民币1,149亿元

headlines.title_en: China Mobile: 2026 H1 Operating Revenue Reaches 538 Billion Yuan, Down 1.1% YoY
headlines.summary_en: China Mobile: In the first half of 2026, the company's operating revenue reached RMB 538 billion, down 1.1% year-on-year, but grew positively on a comparable basis. Among this, main business revenue reached RMB 452.7 billion, down 3.1% year-on-year; other business revenue was RMB 85.4 billion, up 11.2%. Revenue from computing power services and intelligent services accounted for 22.6% of main business revenue, up 2.2 percentage points year-on-year. Profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 78.9 billion, down 6.3% year-on-year, but grew positively on a comparable basis, with earnings per share of RMB 3.64; EBITDA was RMB 173.6 billion, down 6.6%, with EBITDA accounting for 38.4% of main business revenue; profitability maintained a leading level among global first-tier operators. Net operating cash inflow was RMB 114.9 billion.

headlines.title: 存储芯片巨头长鑫科技成为中国陆港两地上市公司市值冠军
headlines.summary: 中国存储芯片巨头长鑫科技在科创板上市仅两周多后，收盘总市值首次赶超腾讯，跃居中国陆港两地上市公司市值首位。长鑫科技周四盘中一度上涨逾4%，但尾盘回吐涨幅，小幅收低。不过相较发行价，该股累计涨幅仍超过500%，总市值达到约3.54万亿元人民币。相比之下，腾讯在公布二季度业绩后股价走低，市场对其大幅增加人工智能相关资本开支可能拖累盈利能力和现金流表现感到担忧，其市值降至折合约3.44万亿元人民币。

headlines.title_en: Memory Chip Giant ChangXin Technology Becomes Most Valuable Listed Company in Both Chinese Mainland and Hong Kong Markets
headlines.summary_en: Chinese memory chip giant Changxin Technology, just over two weeks after its STAR Market listing, saw its closing total market value surpass Tencent for the first time, ranking first among companies listed on the mainland and Hong Kong exchanges. Changxin Technology rose over 4% intraday on Thursday but gave back gains in late trading, closing slightly lower. However, the stock has still surged over 500% from its issuance price, with total market value reaching approximately RMB 3.54 trillion. In comparison, Tencent's share price fell after reporting second-quarter results, as the market worried that its substantial increase in AI-related capital expenditure could weigh on profitability and cash flow, with its market value dropping to approximately RMB 3.44 trillion.
